Exists fun a =>
  Exists fun b =>
    Exists fun c =>
      Exists fun d =>
        Exists fun e =>
          And (instLTNat.lt 0 a)
            (And (instLTNat.lt 0 b)
              (And (instLTNat.lt 0 c)
                (And (instLTNat.lt 0 d)
                  (Eq
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow a 5) (instHPow.hPow b 5)) (instHPow.hPow c 5))
                      (instHPow.hPow d 5))
                    (instHPow.hPow e 5)))))
